Tea Tree Oil

Essential Oil essential-oil antimicrobial antifungal topical skin

Evidence: traditional

Summary

Antimicrobial essential oil; effective against bacteria, fungi, and viruses when used topically.

Indications

  • skin infections
  • athlete's foot
  • wound care
  • acne
  • dandruff
  • fungal infections

Contraindications

  • do not ingest
  • avoid eyes and mucous membranes
  • keep away from pets (cats)

Preparations

  • diluted topical (1-5%)
  • carrier oil blend

Body Systems Affected

  • integumentary
  • immune

Treats These Ailments

Conditions listed as treatable by this remedy:

  • Eczema & Skin Disorders
    Chronic inflammatory skin conditions causing dry, itchy, inflamed skin; includes eczema, psoriasis, and dermatitis.
  • Metabolic Syndrome
    Cluster of conditions including high blood pressure, high blood sugar, excess body fat around the waist, and abnormal cholesterol levels.
